consent_records_granted_complete.name: consent_records_granted_complete
consent_records_granted_complete.value: "consent_records"."status" <> 'granted' OR ("consent_records"."method" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_records"."policy_version" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_records"."granted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_records"."age_band" IS NOT NULL)

attempts_started_check.name: attempts_started_check
attempts_started_check.value: "attempts"."status" = 'created' OR ("attempts"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "attempts"."deadline_at" IS NOT NULL)

coin_ledger_amount_sign_check.name: coin_ledger_amount_sign_check
coin_ledger_amount_sign_check.value:
("coin_ledger"."kind" = 'earn' AND "coin_ledger"."amount" >= 0)
       OR ("coin_ledger"."kind" = 'redeem' AND "coin_ledger"."amount" < 0)
       OR ("coin_ledger"."kind" = 'refund' AND "coin_ledger"."amount" > 0)
       OR ("coin_ledger"."kind" = 'adjust' AND "coin_ledger"."amount" <> 0)

credit_ledger_amount_sign_check.name: credit_ledger_amount_sign_check
credit_ledger_amount_sign_check.value:
("credit_ledger"."kind" = 'grant' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" > 0)
       OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" = 'reserve' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" < 0)
       OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" = 'charge' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" >= 0)
       OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" = 'refund' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" > 0)
       OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" = 'expire' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" < 0)

credit_ledger_request_id_check.name: credit_ledger_request_id_check
credit_ledger_request_id_check.value: "credit_ledger"."kind" NOT IN ('reserve', 'charge', 'refund') OR "credit_ledger"."request_id" IS NOT NULL

entitlements_source_ref_check.name: entitlements_source_ref_check
entitlements_source_ref_check.value: ("entitlements"."source" <> 'subscription' OR "entitlements"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("entitlements"."source" <> 'order' OR "entitlements"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)

payments_parent_check.name: payments_parent_check
payments_parent_check.value: "payments"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payments"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL
